input_text: summarize for student | category: announcements | dates: June 10, 2025; June 10th 2025; July 1, 2025 | notice: Announcement of IUCEE Student Chapter Competition 2025 Dear Students, Greetings! We are pleased to share with you an exciting opportunity to participate in the IUCEE Student Chapter Competition 2025 – an initiative aimed at fostering innovation, sustainability, and interdisciplinary collaboration among student chapters of IUCEE-affiliated institutions. This competition invites student teams to submit project proposals aligned with Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Shortlisted teams will receive mentorship and may be provided partial funding to build working prototypes, which will be showcased during ICTIEE 2026 (IASF). 🔗 Participation Form: [URL1] 📌 Key Highlights: Team Composition: Maximum 5 students + 1 faculty mentor – At least 3 students must be from 2nd or 3rd year – Interdisciplinary teams encouraged – Minimum 2 students must have completed a Design Thinking course Project Focus: Innovative solutions addressing any of the SDG targets (refer Annexure 1 attached) Submission Deadline: June 10, 2025 Preference: Proposals with a working Proof of Concept will be prioritized Recognition: Shortlisted projects will be mentored and top 5 will be showcased at ICTIEE 2026, with awards and potential incubation support for the winning team. This is an incredible chance to demonstrate your creativity, develop sustainable innovations, and gain national recognition. We encourage you to form your teams, brainstorm impactful ideas, and submit your proposals at the earliest. For any queries, feel free to reach out. Best regards, Dr. Sunny Nanade, Faculty In-Charge NMIMS IUCEE Student Chapter, NMIMS MPSTME Trailing email for your kind reference: IUCEE Student Chapter Competition 2025 IUCEE is thrilled to announce an exciting competition designed to foster innovation, collaboration, and impactful contributions from its dynamic network of student chapters. This competition serves as a platform for you to showcase your chapter's activities, projects, and initiatives that align with IUCEE's mission of enhancing the quality and relevance of engineering education. We encourage all IUCEE student chapters to participate in this competition. This competition will not only provide recognition for your efforts but also serve as a valuable platform for sharing best practices and inspiring other chapters within the IUCEE network. The competition is open to all active student members of IUCEE-affiliated engineering college chapters. What is the Competition? Competition involves a project proposal from each team based on Sustainable Design Goals and prioritize environmental sustainability, resource efficiency, and the use of eco-friendly materials and practices. List of SDG goals selected for the competition are attached as an Annexure 1. Selected projects will be considered for partial financial support by IUCEE Foundation to build working prototypes which needs to be demonstrated at IASF in January 2026. Participation Guidelines Student teams should consist of a max 5 students and a faculty mentor. Out of the team of 5, at least 3 students Contatshould be from 2nd and/or 3rd year of engineering. Students should be from different departments for interdisciplinary categories. At least 2 of the participants should have undergone a course on Design Thinking. Next Step: Submit detailed project proposal (preferably with Proof of Concept) by June 10th 2025 Participating teams will work on any of the targets under SDGs in Annexure 1, and come up with a) problem definition and b) solution which can help in achieving that target. The teams are expected to submit a detailed project proposal with problem definition, proposed solution and details of how the solution works. The teams who submit Proof of Concept along with the project proposal would be given preference in selection. IUCEE will shortlist the projects based on their alignment to SDG, innovative solution and potential to succeed as a product in the long term. The list of selected projects for further work will be communicated by July 1, 2025. IUCEE will provide mentorship to shortlisted projects to develop their idea further and convert them into a demonstrable prototype by Dec 2025. Top 5 shortlisted project teams will be invited to bring their prototype and demonstrate it at ICTIEE 2026 IASF. Panel of judges will choose a winner of the competition during IASF & will receive suitable recognition & award. IUCEE can facilitate the winners to incubate it as a business idea if they choose to pursue it further.
